finding: The display is the canonical base-change morphism v*(R^q u_* F)→R^q u′_*(v′*F).
source_page_224_relation: Set u=i, v=g, v′=f, u′=i′, q=0. The displayed arrow is g*i_*E→i′_*f*E; the same construction is applied degree by degree to the complex E. Thus the printed EGAIII1.4.15.4 reference identifies exactly the stated map.
